allow: PowerShell(python -c "import inspect, deepgram; from deepgram import DeepgramClient; c = DeepgramClient\(api_key='x'\); print\(inspect.signature\(c.listen.v1.connect\)\)")

PowerShell($p = Start-Process -FilePath "backend\\venv\\Scripts\\python.exe" -ArgumentList "run_server.py" -WorkingDirectory "backend" -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru; $healthy = $false; foreach \($i in 1..30\) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 1000; try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:8080/health" -TimeoutSec 2; $healthy = $true; break } catch {} ; if \($p.HasExited\) { Write-Output "process exited early: $\($p.ExitCode\)"; break } }; if \($healthy\) { Write-Output "HEALTHY: $\($r | ConvertTo-Json -Compress\)" }; if \(-not $p.HasExited\) { Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -Confirm:$false; Write-Output "backend stopped" })
